theorems.name: Submission.dor_lmb_fcd_cp_slice_integral
theorems.statement: ∀ (m : ℕ) (δ : ℝ) (k : Fin (m + 1)) (h : Euclid (m + 1) → ℝ), IntegrableOn h {y : Euclid (m + 1) | ∀ i, δ < y i ∧ y i < 1 - δ} → ∫ x in {y : Euclid (m + 1) | ∀ i, δ < y i ∧ y i < 1 - δ}, ∫ t in Ioo δ (1 - δ), h (WithLp.toLp 2 (Function.update (WithLp.ofLp x) k t)) = (1 - 2 * δ) * ∫ x in {y : Euclid (m + 1) | ∀ i, δ < y i ∧ y i < 1 - δ}, h x
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
